about_short_description.short_description: RASPIRE is a cybersecurity company that offers an AI-powered platform providing no-code runtime protection for mobile apps.

product.name: Mobile Security as a Service
product.description: A no-code solution that secures Android and iOS apps by providing multi-layered protection against various threats without requiring code changes or SDKs.

product.name: Application Shielding
product.description: A service that offers comprehensive protection for mobile apps, including runtime application self-protection (RASP) and compliance with regulatory requirements.

product.name: Root/Jailbreak Detection
product.description: Detects rooted or jailbroken devices to ensure apps run in a secure environment.

product.name: Anti-Hooking
product.description: Prevents external code from modifying or intercepting app execution.

product.name: Anti-Tampering
product.description: Monitors and prevents unauthorized changes to app code or data.

product.name: Anti-Debugging
product.description: Blocks debugging tools and techniques to protect against reverse-engineering.
